name: R9 Steel Shell Armor of Andras

system.description:
At the start of the scene you gain [Cancel (attacks from other than Close): 10]. [Trigger: Action] Use together with one of your actions with the [Stance] tag. Your next damage roll gets +5 (this effect is treated as a Combat Status and is removed once it takes effect). Armor crafted from a shard chipped off the steel dragon's shell. The armor's plates change shape in accordance with the wearer's intent, assisting in both attack and defense.

Steel Dragon Shell [Core Material] (180G) + Lamellar Armor (530G) + Iron Shield (150G) + [Magic Catalyst 9] (90G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (480G)
